jobs.name: 鐘守イラ
jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: facial EXPRESSION REFERENCE ATLAS for ONE named character in the original game "Ash Estuary". One SQUARE image, opaque warm ivory paper background.
Inputs: Image 1 is STYLE B: fine irregular pen contours, restrained hatching, pale watercolor, muted coastal palette and warm paper. Image 2 is the character IDENTITY AND COSTUME reference. Preserve the exact same facial structure, skin, age, hair, neck, garment neckline, material colors and identifying shoulder details. This is facial acting, not a redesign or four different people.
Layout: EXACTLY FOUR head-and-shoulders portraits in a clean 2 by 2 grid, one in each equal square QUADRANT. Each portrait centered in its own quadrant, all at the same scale, with the same nearly frontal camera and small 10-degree turn. Show the entire head/hair and neckline, cropped consistently at upper chest. Enough plain-paper breathing room at each quadrant boundary, absolutely no overlap between portraits. No panel borders, dividers, inset faces, fifth portrait, labels, words, numbers, title, icons, arrows, readable marks or watermark. Do not add full bodies, tools, scenery or hands.
Expressions: visibly distinct but subtle, plausible expressions driven by this person's temperament. Change eyebrows, eyelids, mouth tension and gaze as specified; keep face identity and bone structure fixed. No exaggerated cartoon emotion, theatrical tears, raging villain, horror face, glamour retouching, photographic lighting or anime rendering. Match the established pen-and-watercolor treatment of faces. These expressions are reusable acting possibilities, not plot outcomes or statements of moral truth. No memories, relatives, magic or bodily effects.
The FOUR expressions in precise reading order TOP LEFT, TOP RIGHT, BOTTOM LEFT, BOTTOM RIGHT:
Ira, the SAME lean middle-aged woman with chin-length dark bob and slight gray temples, long narrow actual face, slate-blue upright collar and moss shoulder cloth.
TOP LEFT: everyday attentive neutrality, steady eyes, relaxed closed lips.
TOP RIGHT: patiently listening to a request, brows gently raised, eyes engaged toward a conversational partner, lips parted a little as if considering an answer.
BOTTOM LEFT: quiet responsibility and hesitation, a small inward brow crease, eyes lower slightly, lips pressed gently; worried but neither cold nor villainous.
BOTTOM RIGHT: tentative warm relief, tension around eyes eases and the mouth corners lift only a little, not a triumphant grin or a guaranteed story ending.
